statement: The proportion of SUID cases among infants born to mothers with different pre-pregnancy health behaviors and conditions varies.
rationale: This study design uses the case series (ncfrp_v51) for numerator, population reference (prams_p7_arf, prams_p8_arf) for exposure prevalence, and denominator source (cdc_natl15) to estimate live births stratified by maternal pre-pregnancy health behaviors. The design can identify associations but cannot establish causation or fully control for confounding variables.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C9 suggests an association between maternal smoking and higher SUID incidence, but does not address pre-pregnancy behaviors comprehensively.
required_concepts: Live births stratified by maternal pre-pregnancy health behaviors
cannot_establish: Causality, individual-level linkage between case series and population reference datasets.
